text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the academy grounds—
I spotted Yaeno Muteki talking to Sakura Chiyono O
with a deeply troubled expression.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, so... you want me to
join you for singing practice,
is that right, desu ne?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In truth...
there is a genre of song that I find completely unbearable.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Namely... songs with, r-r-romantic elements...
Whether listening to them or singing them,
I am overcome with intense embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I see... Love songs, huh.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However... as there is always a possibility of performing them
at a Winning Live, whining is out of the question!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A victory that lacks the finishing touch is utterly unacceptable!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore!
I must conquer this sense of shame at all costs!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall endure whatever training it takes...
Please, assist me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Understood!
They do say "Hard work always pays off," so let's give it our best, desu ne!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's start by reading the lyrics aloud
and gradually get you used to them!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: O-Osu! Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
『The moment we part, I-I always feel so lonely...
Y-Your... p-palm's? W-Wuh, wa-warmth... is...!』

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Guhaah!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: W-What's wrong!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
B-B-Because... N-No, well...
T-These lyrics are far more scandalous than I imagined...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
F-From just that!?
Um, you shouldn't push yourself too hard...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—N-Nay! If I retreat here...
I would be surrendering to my own weakness!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
『I-If only... b-b-back then... I c-could have said... I-I wuv, l-love you!』
...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Had I formally requested your hand in courtship...
Perhaps a different future might... or might not have awaited us...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Yaeno-san!
Though you're clearly rewriting the lyrics!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: 『H-How helpless I f-feel, if only y-you kneww...』

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...When a general prepares to convey their heartfelt devotion,
how forlorn is the maiden's spirit within...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-It turned into classical poetry!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Though merely four syllables,
their weight surpasses mountains,
and runs deeper than the oceans...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Dost thou not know, my beloved,
that none other exists in this world save thee—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
............
That's the end... right?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...W-What a blunder!
To succumb to weakness and flee into my own improvisation...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...No!
Actually, doing it your own way totally works!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sure, you took huge artistic liberties...
but thanks to that, it brings out Yaeno-san's signature cool dignity, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I came up with a maxim about this before!
"Individuality is a runner's unique horseshoe"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Instead of forcing yourself to conform, pursue a singing style that only you can deliver!
That's the best approach!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san...!
...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, the classical poetry I have long cherished
is also an unvarnished expression of one's deepest emotions...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Whether it is a song of romance or ancient verse,
what true difference lies between them?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then I need only... express my true, authentic self
to the fullest upon that stage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki wore a bright, unburdened smile—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Just as you say, I shall have more faith in myself,
hone my craft... and show everyone a splendid performance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To that end, I must expose myself to and study even more!
...Until I have mastered every classical poem in existence!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, that's not it at all!?
The goal subtly shifted on you, Yaeno-san!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, it seemed Yaeno Muteki gained
some confidence regarding love poems.
